title: Algerian Chicken Jubilant Burger
description: A flavorful and spicy burger featuring algerian spices and served with a jubilant twist.

ingredients.name: algerian spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern or north african markets

ingredients.name: jubilant sauce
ingredients.notes: see jubilant sauce recipe for details

instructions: Season the chicken breast with algerian spice blend and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the burger buns on the grill.
Spread a layer of jubilant sauce on the bottom bun.
Add a slice of cheese, a few slices of red onion, a few leaves of lettuce, and a tomato slice.
Add a cooked chicken breast on top of the vegetables.
Top with the remaining bun half.
